title: A Letter for the Ledger
author: Mara Sterling
blurb: Freya Delacroix, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, has spent three years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
